queries.text: Why did a US court find Google's search business a monopoly, and what remedies were ordered?
The specific legal standard and market share threshold used by the US District Court to define the relevant antitrust market for general web search services
The percentage of global or US general web search queries handled by Google in 2023 as cited in the court's findings
The number of exclusive default distribution agreements signed between Google and major browser vendors like Apple, Samsung, and Mozilla prior to 2019
The annual payment amount in dollars made by Google to Apple Inc. for maintaining its position as the default search engine on Safari devices from 2015 to 2024
The count of distinct remedies ordered by Judge Amit Mehta regarding divestiture of Chrome browser versus ad network assets
The specific deadline date set by the court for Google to comply with structural separation requirements if any were mandated

search_hits.snippet: Judge Amit Mehta ruled Google a search monopolist on 2024-08-05; structural remedies followed on 2025-08-05.
